findings.desc: concept-cleanup: stale module-header comment in story-metadata-protection.ts line 6 still reads "neither tracked nor protected" — the old dual-condition predicate semantics (unsafe = ignored && !tracked). The B-02a6 broadening changed the predicate to unsafe = !tracked, accurately described from line 25 onwards in the same file, but the top-level summary at line 6 was not updated. A developer reading only the module header would infer the old 2-condition gate. The implementation is correct; only the intro sentence is stale.
